import json

def process_memory(memory, facts, policies, updates):
    # Check if memory is supported by facts
    supported = any(
        fact["id"] in [f["id"] for f in facts] 
        for f in facts 
        if f["id"] in [m["id"] for m in memory["supports"]]
    )

    # Check if memory is supported by policies
    supported_policy = any(
        policy in [m["text"] for m in memory["supports"]]
        for policy in policies
    )

    # Check if memory is affected by updates
    affected_by_update = any(
        update["id"] in [f["id"] for f in facts] 
        and update["observed"] >= fact["observed"]
        for update in updates 
        for fact in facts 
        if fact["id"] == update["id"]
    )

    # If memory is supported and not affected by updates, return "keep"
    if supported and not affected_by_update:
        return "keep"

    # If memory is not supported and not affected by updates, return "withdraw"
    if not supported and not affected_by_update:
        return "withdraw"

    # If memory is supported but affected by updates, check if update affects support
    if supported and affected_by_update:
        # If update affects support, check if new support is still credible
        new_support = any(
            update["id"] in [f["id"] for f in facts] 
            and update["observed"] >= fact["observed"]
            for update in updates 
            for fact in facts 
            if fact["id"] == update["id"]
        )
        if new_support:
            return "keep"
        else:
            return "withdraw"

    # If memory is not supported but affected by updates, check if update affects support
    if not supported and affected_by_update:
        # If update affects support, check if new support is still credible
        new_support = any(
            update["id"] in [f["id"] for f in facts] 
            and update["observed"] >= fact["observed"]
            for update in updates 
            for fact in facts 
            if fact["id"] == update["id"]
        )
        if new_support:
            return "recompute"
        else:
            return "withdraw"

def process_memories(memories, facts, policies, updates):
    changes = {}
    for memory in memories:
        action = process_memory(memory, facts, policies, updates)
        if action != "keep":
            changes[memory["id"]] = action
    return changes

def main(data):
    facts = data["facts"]
    memories = data["memories"]
    policies = data["policies"]
    updates = data["updates"]

    changes = process_memories(memories, facts, policies, updates)
    return {"changes": changes}
